description: Call once the task is finished (or abandoned). Ends this session in the helper: forgets element numbers, change baselines and screenshots, drops "For this task" approvals and hides the status overlay and live preview. If the user pressed Stop (haltedByUser) or declined access, end the session and ask the user how to proceed; do not call observe_app or any action again until the user explicitly asks you to continue.
name: finish
title: Finish
